notes:
CRM notes:
- Company: Lakehaven Interactives — mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building in-app assistant + cross-doc search.
- Use-case details: primary traffic is support chat (peaks M-F 9-18 PST), embeddings for product docs + user guides, reranking for search results. Latency target: 150-250ms tail for chat vitals; throughput: steady-state ~600 req/min, peak burst ~3x.
- POC highlights: hosted API POC demonstrated sub-250ms median with batching+KV caching on trimmed context; embeddings recall >0.8 for most queries. POC cost projection ~ $8k/mo on hosted for pilot workload.
- Procurement ask: move to Dedicated to reduce unit cost and lock capacity. Key negotiation items: committed GPUs (4 vs 6), burst allowance (% of commit), overage pricing per GPU-hour, ramp schedule (months 1-6), and termination/true-up terms. Finance said: "we can do 12-month commit if burst is limited to 50% and first 60 days are pro-rated."
- Security: require SSO/SAML + SOC2 + audit logs, EU data residency for EU customers. Asked for KMS integration steps and proof of key separation.
- Quotes from product lead: "We want predictable invoices and a soft cap on burst — unpredictable overages break our margins."
- SE notes: recommend Dedicated with 4 committed GPUs, 50% burst pool, monthly true-up, and 8-week ramp (25% increments). Proposed pricing appendix attached.
- Sales strategy: push narrow SOW (support assistant + embeddings) now; expand to summarization later. Offer a 4-week initial credit on overage for first 2 months to ease finance sign-off.
- Misc: legal has redlines on data residency clause; security team requested sample audit logs and KMS integration doc.
